messages:
maria_support: Hey team — auditor from one of our customers (CareCloud) just sent a formal request asking for ISO 27001 mapping and evidence around our KMS/HSM usage, audit log retention, and incident repro for a recent auth failure. They want a single artifact they can reference for controls A.8/A.12/A.13 etc. Can someone own?
anya_security: I can take point on the ISO mapping. Quick Q: do they expect the full Statement of Applicability or just control mappings + evidence pointers? (they've asked for 'evidence' specifically)
maria_support: They said "evidence or pointer to artefacts" — auditor prefers direct attachments but will accept links to our secure Evidence Repo (S3 with pre-signed short-lived links). They also want a timeline + repro steps for the auth failure that caused token refresh errors on 2026-02-28.
sam_sre: tagging @anya_security — I have the incident notes and request traces. Short summary: token refresh endpoint  /v1/auth/refresh returned 503 for ~11m, causing retries and increased billing due to repeated invoices attempts. Root cause was a transient DB failover + our retry backoff not kicking in. I can export traces and the raw request IDs.
devon_prod: For the KMS/HSM evidence: Our private deploys use customer KMS; hosted uses AWS KMS (multi-tenant CMK under our account) with CloudHSM-backed key material. Evidence items we can provide:
- KMS key metadata (ARNs, rotation policy)
- CloudHSM cluster config + HSM serials (redacted as needed)
- KMS access logs (CloudTrail) for ops key usage
anya_security: Good list. Auditor will want proof of key separation and key access control. We should include:
- Key policy snippets showing only the KMS service role + security-admins can use admin APIs
- CMK rotation schedule and proof of rotation (timestamped events)
- HSM tamper/health events and who had operator access that month
maria_support: They also asked about audit / retention: how long do we keep API request/response logs, auth traces, and billing/usage records for hosted customers?
sam_sre: Current retention: request-level traces and full request/response payloads are retained 30 days in hot storage, 12 months in cold storage (logs-indexed). Billing/usage aggregates retained for 7 years per finance. Auth traces (token exchange errors) stored 90 days with full context, 12 months aggregated metrics. I can attach the retention config snippets.
devon_prod: Note: for privacy we scrub user PII from traces after ingestion. For audit we can provide redacted samples and a retention policy doc (internal: docs/security/log-retention-2025.pdf).
maria_support: Auditor also wants reproducible steps for the auth failure: a concise repro they can run or a set of logs showing the failure chain. Can we create a sanitized repro harness or at least a deterministic set of request IDs + timeline?
sam_sre: I can produce a sanitized timeline file with request IDs (anonymized), sequence of events, and the exact error traces. Example snippet:
```
2026-02-28T14:05:03Z request_id=abc123 service=token refresh error: DB connection refused
2026-02-28T14:05:11Z request_id=abc124 retry attempt 1 -> 503
2026-02-28T14:10:00Z db-failover-complete
```
I'll also include the backoff config we used (we've since patched to exponential backoff with jitter).
anya_security: For ISO mapping, I'll produce a mapping doc that links each ISO control to our artifacts. Example mapping entries:
- A.9 (Access control): link to IAM roles + key policy snippets
- A.12.4 (Logging and monitoring): link to log retention policy + SIEM ingestion proof
- A.10.1 (Cryptographic controls): KMS/CloudHSM evidence
Make sure each link is to pre-signed evidence artifacts and include a hash for integrity verification.
maria_support: Auditor also wants to know who to contact for evidence validation if they see anomalies. Can we provide a point of contact and SLA for evidence delivery?
devon_prod: Provide sec-ops@redwood.com for evidence clarifications. Delivery SLA: initial package within 3 business days, follow-ups within 2 business days.
audit-bot: [auto] Evidence package prepared: 2026-03-02T09:22:00Z. Items: iso-mapping-v1.pdf, kms-evidence-bundle.zip (redacted), auth-repro-timeline.json (sanitized). Signed by anya_security.
maria_support: Perfect. Action items:
- @anya_security: produce ISO mapping doc and signed evidence index
- @sam_sre: export sanitized traces + repro timeline
- @devon_prod: collect KMS/HSM artifacts and retention policy docs, add redaction notes
I'll compile and send to the auditor. ETA: EOD 2026-03-04
anya_security: Ack. I'll prioritize the mapping and include the control-by-control rationale. Will attach short excerpts of key policies inline for faster review.
sam_sre: I'll dump the traces and include sanitized request sequences. Will also attach the patch PR that changed retry policy: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/4821
devon_prod: I'll zip the CloudTrail exports (limited window), KMS key metadata, and the HSM audit logs (redacted). Note: CloudHSM serials stripped as per compliance.
maria_support: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the auditor once package is ready. If they come back with follow-up technical questions, loop @anya_security and @sam_sre. :thumbsup:
anya_security: One more: add a statement on encryption at rest for ephemeral caches (redis shards) — we use envelope encryption with KMS-wrapped keys. I'll add example config lines.
maria_support: Great. Closing the thread once package sent."
